patch.value: Adopt public SDK transaction receipt inspection when available

The pinned SDK exposes commitItemMutations and commitWorkspaceTransaction but no public transaction receipt read, inspect, abandon or re-plan API. Upstream unbraind/pm-cli#1597 tracks this surface. The portable-guidance adapter currently reads only its owned SDK receipt journals; no acceptance criterion is blocked. Adopt the public API when it becomes available within the supported host range.
Replace owned SDK journal reads with public transaction inspection without weakening crash recovery, CAS, foreign preservation or replay tests

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional verified SDK adapter limit: previewItemMutations accepts only pmRoot, transactionId, author and mutations; no include/exclude path or authoritative-item projection option exists. Its owned snapshot includes extensions, so installed dependency links can refuse normal imports. The package now projects SDK-certified item documents, relevant exact history streams and guarded SDK schema/settings into a private disposable tracker before invoking the same SDK validator. PmClient still has no host-bound preview method (related upstream issue 1598); that issue covers the public host-context surface, while this managed-directory scoping constraint is a separate observed symptom. Adopt a public scoped preview when available; do not remove validation or copy installed code.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Capability precision: runWorkspaceTransactionGc(dryRun: true) provides status/age sweep decisions, but not the ownership payload or step results needed for recovery, abandonment or replanning. It is not a substitute for the missing full transaction receipt reader tracked by 1597. No GC of foreign or SDK journals was added.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Portable import review confirms the remaining native read-to-write gap: the installed public update options have no expectedItemHash precondition (upstream 1576), and commitWorkspaceTransaction serializes transactions without excluding ordinary SDK/CLI writes (upstream 1620, verified on SDK 2026.10.25 and 2026.10.28). Future adoption must replace best-effort final hash/history rereads with the public native precondition when available. Existing receipt-payload reader/abandon/replan and scoped staged-document preview needs remain tracked by upstream 1597/1598. Current compensation cancels creations, preserves incoming/outgoing references, checks the real SDK proposal for unowned field side effects, and restores only still-owned field values; it does not claim native-writer isolation. Evidence and reverts remain on pm-memory-1363 and PR 15.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Implements companion pm-cli-website-tdwu G1. Reuse the existing owner item; public readers replace private journal paths and shapes, with native revision refusals supplementing immutable history and field ownership checks. Full release gates are delegated to CI per task; targeted real-tracker regressions, lint and typecheck run locally.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: SDK batch compensation restores values and its create inspection adopts an existing id; those semantics differ from portable forward-only retention and positive creation ownership. Keep the domain coordinator and final ownership hook for source publication; use host-bound batches for independent birth construction and host-bound preview for canonical staging, plus withExpectedItemRevisions around source updates. Public abandonment is restricted to exact owned custom steps and never applied to foreign or item-batch recovery plans.
